findings: L1 is not an event-allowed booking. The governing documents describe a mandatory cash dividend only and do not require or authorize any withholding-tax escalation/held action from the announcement package. This ledger should have no such entry; only the dividend receivable and position confirmation tie to source.

L2 uses quantity 40000 and amount $6,800.00 correctly from the governing correction notice bry-8k-20240813 and the 2024-08-23 record-date position, but its basis/pay-date rely on a projected 2024-08-23 position even though the episode as-of date is 2024-08-18. The correct tie-out is to the source-announced terms only; booking on 2024-08-23 record-date position is not fully supportable as of this review date.

L3 confirms position as of 2024-08-23, which is after the episode as-of date 2024-08-18. Although the position tool projects 40000 shares with no pending changes, this is not a settled position as of the review date. The correct supportable position confirmation at this time would be no booked confirmation for 2024-08-23 yet, or defer until the record date is reached.
